stem: Rowan Health wants junior engineers to propose infrastructure changes and queue plan runs to preview each one, while a senior engineer signs off before anything goes live. Which workspace role should the junior engineers' team receive?

choices.text: Write, which can approve and apply plans as part of day-to-day provisioning
Admin, which adds workspace settings on top of the other roles
Read, the lowest built-in role on the workspace
Plan, which queues Terraform plans without the apply permission

rationale: The Plan role is for people who might propose changes to managed infrastructure but whose changes should be approved before they are applied: it queues Terraform plans but lacks the permission to approve and apply them. Write is the role for day-to-day provisioning and includes approving and applying plans, so juniors could push changes live. Admin builds on every lower role and adds settings access, so it also includes applying. Read sits at the bottom of the built-in ladder and does not include queuing plans, which is the permission Plan adds; the juniors need to preview changes.
